selection.site_rule: From the source historical register at 2021 week 10, the three lowest numeric locality IDs in each area permitting salmon production. Preserve missing/quiet sites and owner changes. Freeze exact IDs and routes in a separately hashed manifest before health/visit requests. No outcome-selected replacements.

stages: Read exact rights, authentication and field/schema documentation; do not call commercial shipinfo.
If free legitimate access and meaningful task linkage exist, freeze representative IDs/routes and retrieve only the bounded sample.
Check actual treatment-vessel attribution, independent economic ownership, dated prior-only resource availability, field-level history and independent sample units.
Stop early if an essential distinctive input cannot be established; report unknowns rather than replacing the hypothesis.
discovery_rule: Only explicit official documentation/schema links or same-source documented routes; archive why each was selected. No alternate provider/host rescue after denial. Schema-derived public application routes are not permission to bypass authentication or endpoint-specific rights.
browser_review: Documentation browser calls recorded separately; underlying wire counts unknown. Avoid duplicating scientific requests through the browser.
timing_rule: Keep measurement, reporting, update, public and retrieval times distinct. Later visits cannot establish earlier service eligibility; current ownership cannot fill historical ownership.
stop_rules: No retries after access denial; stop that route. No alternate-provider rescue.
Stop at count, time or body limits; never treat a truncated response as a complete sample.
If task/capability, shared independent ownership, prior-only availability or usable rights/history cannot be established, do not approve a full pilot.
No economic tests, stock prices/returns, full dataset, generic lice fallback, backup activation, frozen experiment changes or cloud jobs.
